INSERT INTO heartbeats
            (monitor_id, ts, status, latency_ms, status_code, msg, retries, important)
        SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
            $1::uuid[],
            $2::timestamptz[],
            $3::text[]::monitor_status[],
            $4::int[],
            $5::int[],
            $6::text[],
            $7::int[],
            $8::bool[]
        )
        ON CONFLICT (monitor_id, ts) DO NOTHING
